name: War Disciples
genericName: War Cultists||Champions of Conquest||Champions of Wa'rghul
background:
The Havoc Disciples are those who have embraced a particular Havoc God. Each god bestows unique boons and powers onto their followers. As a result, their warbands are specialized, shaped to reflect the whims of their god. 

Forsaken by the Empire, the northern tribes were approached by different gods who offered a chance at survival in exchange for worship. Each god empowered their respective followers, reforging them according to their will. After their defeat in the Havoc Wars, the Disciples were severed from their former patrons, but with the Rift’s opening, they are eager to renew their pacts after many years spent in bitter exile.
backgroundFull:
The arrival of the Havoc Gods in Tyria caused a great deal of instability, as some began to worship these new Gods. The Empire recalled many of their troops to defend their Capital and nearby regions, hoping to put down any rebellions there, whilst the northern tribes were abandoned and left to deal with any dangers on their own. 

The Havoc Gods’ eyes soon turned to this forsaken province, seeking potential converts and champions. Each Havoc God sought to sway promising individuals and powerful tribes to their influence, granting their favourites various boons in exchange for worship. 

The God of War offered strength, allowing its Disciples to triumph over their foes. Change granted knowledge and powerful magic. Plague offered renewed vitality to those taken by disease. While Lust offered redemption and power to those cast out by the Empire. 

These gifts offered renewed hope and life amongst the desperate tribes whom the Empire had abandoned. Those who accepted the pact were granted powerful boons by their patrons, who reforged them in their image. These Havoc Disciples repaid their gifts with a fanatical loyalty, willing to devote their lives to the god who had chosen them. Each tribe defined themselves according to their worship, establishing themselves through their devotion and worship of their particular patron. By the time the Havoc Wars had begun in full, the remaining northern tribes had utterly changed, each one fully embracing one or more of the Havoc Gods.

When the Havoc Gods were captured, their most fanatical followers were suddenly severed from their life’s purpose. Some fought to their deaths, eager to give their lives to avenge their god. Others fled north, scattered and weakened, but persisting. They maintained a long vigil,  inflicting what revenge they could while awaiting the return of their particular patron. Without direction or hope however, many fell into despair. Petty conflicts began to break out between bands dedicated to different gods, as they sought to lay blame for defeat upon each other.

Then, the Great Rift opened and liberated their Gods into Tyria. Havoc Disciples find themselves with renewed hope, eager to prove their loyalty to their old patrons. Yet, the bitterness of defeat and rivalries remain, as many remember their years in hiding, and they are no longer the unified force that once rampaged through the land.

How will your devotion guide you?

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Warbound
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies for the first time each round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Bloodthirsty Fighter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 1 that enemies roll when blocking hits from this model's weapons in melee, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Steadfast Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when charging.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Scout Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Versatile Expert
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Purge
specialRules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Scourge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon counts as having dealt 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Warbound Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Warbound. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Warbound
specialRules.description: If this model has Warbound, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Warbound (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Violent
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies for the first time each round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Violent
specialRules.description: If this model has Violent, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Violent (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"" range to a min. of 6" when shooting at it.

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: This model may be placed anywhere within 12” after being deployed.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense
specialRules.description: As long as a unit where most models have this rule hasn't activated yet this round, pick one effect when it is attacked: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as enemy models in the target unit and within 3” of it. Hits must be split evenly between all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (players pick how).
